description: Test N11, redone from scratch on an A100 (deviation D1): a functional payload at three strengths (lambda 8, 32, 128, on head B's readout only, amendment A1) against a fixed yardstick, with clean, unanchored and geometric arms. 5 seeds, 30 training runs, measured on test-split windows 1793-2213. NEEDS AN A100: before Run all, choose Runtime > Change runtime type > A100 GPU. On any other GPU it stops before training. At most about 3.5 hours (the T4's pace), probably less. Resumable: if a session ends, choose Run all again and finished work is skipped.
